sprint: Four Studio bugs shipped together: a World-owned object marked moveable is now genuinely rotatable and resizable, not merely repositionable; "More Ideas" becomes "Start Something New", a blank page with no World association at all; the My Projects card's huge empty placeholder is fixed at its real cause (a CSS cascade-order bug); and a creator can finally name their project, from a visible header field.
task: (1) Guardrails: renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawDecorationImage now reads a Story-Author ov.rotation with precedence over the Theme-Author's compiled d.rotation base, and the shape branch of _layerDrawDecoration merges ov.rotation alongside the ov.fillColor it already merged — the exact ov-beats-compiled precedence every other overridable field on these objects follows. js/contextPanel.js's Rotation slider gate widens from v.kind==='text' to text|image|shape (Colour stays excluded — a full-bleed fill has no orientation). Move and Resize already worked at the render layer; the real gap was that rotation had nowhere to land and no reachable control. (2) js/creationFlow.js: the 'more' CREATION_TYPES entry becomes {id:'blank', title:'Start Something New', blank:true} — the one branch on Screen 1, skipping the World screen entirely into a new _finishBlank() that clears theme/artworkTheme to null. Deliberately never applyTheme(null): getTheme(null) substitutes DEFAULT_THEME_ID, so that call would silently INSTALL storybook-classic. applyArtworkTheme(null) IS a real clear and is used for its side effects. (3) The My Projects grid div carried BOTH creation-flow-grid and creation-flow-project-grid; the generic class is defined LATER at equal specificity so its auto-fill/200px rule won and the project grid's own 4-column rule was dead code — dropped the generic class, and capped the thumb at clamp(78px,10vh,110px) instead of an uncapped aspect-ratio:4/5 slab. (4) #bookTitle relocated from hidden-inside-#story-tab into the header, un-hidden, styled as a quiet click-to-type title; same element, same id, so every getElementById consumer is untouched; js/app.js mirrors it into AppState.project.bookTitle on input so in-memory readers stay fresh. Amends Locked Decision #1's 'hide editable Book Name'. Verified: four_bugs_verify 36/36 (resize handles, real setSize, the Rotation slider writing a real override, and a decisive quadrant-PNG pixel check proving the canvas genuinely rotates at 180°; blank path never installs storybook-classic and still renders; grid class/columns/thumb height; naming round-trips into serialize() and My Projects). Regression: both goldenBuilds PASS, Museum Gallery hashes byte-identical (1f54eb660f7beb53 / 843e68f2cffb3c2e / 969a67e5c984647b), fromworld_tile 13/13, photo_via_studio 8/8, bg_default 12/12, fa_replace_everywhere 22/22, placeframe_v2_phase13 21/21, legacy_place_controls 15/15, v2_nudge 28/28, place_host_split 21/21.
